# immich_albums (Data Source)

Fetches the list of albums.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_albums" "albums" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `albums` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--albums))

<a id="nestedatt--albums"></a>
### Nested Schema for `albums`

Read-Only:

- `album_name` (String) The name of the album.
- `album_thumbnail_asset_id` (String) The id of the album's thumbnail asset.
- `created_at` (String) Time at which the album was created.
- `description` (String) The album's description.
- `end_date` (String) Date and time of latest photo in the album.
- `has_shared_link` (Boolean) If true, this album has a shared link.
- `id` (String) Album Id.
- `is_activity_enabled` (Boolean) If true, comments and likes can be left on the album.
- `order` (String) The album order: asc or desc.
- `owner_id` (String) Id of the album's owner.
- `shared` (Boolean) If true, this is a shared album.
- `start_date` (String) Date and time of earliest photo in the album.
- `updated_at` (String) Time at which the album was last updated.
